title: Regex for Parsing Markdown & Raw LLM Outputs
why: LLMs often wrap JSON in markdown blocks ( `json ... ` ) or append conversational chatter before/after structured outputs. Regular expressions allow you to extract the clean payload with precision.
objectives: Extract code blocks from markdown responses
Parse tool call signatures from unstructured text
Sanitize sensitive tokens or PII from user inputs
concept: When models fail to provide clean JSON, regex extraction is your first and most reliable line of defense before calling json.loads().

practice.description: Write a regex that extracts all URLs cited inside an LLM's final markdown response.

requirements: Extract Thought:, Action:, Action Input: from legacy ReAct prompt responses
Transform extracted segments into an executable Python dictionary

checklist: Handled whitespace and multi-line DOTALL parsing
Cleaned extracted payloads prior to downstream JSON decoding
mistakes: Assuming LLMs will always output strictly valid JSON without preamble text
